# APPLIO

> APPLIO is a digital appliance passport platform for managing appliance identity, warranties, service history, maintenance records and lifecycle costs.

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://applio-lifecycle.vercel.app/): APPLIO overview and digital appliance passport introduction.
- [How It Works](https://applio-lifecycle.vercel.app/how-it-works): How APPLIO manages appliance lifecycle records.

## Public Passport

- [Public Passport](https://applio-lifecycle.vercel.app/passport/): Public read-only appliance passport pages are available through appliance-specific URLs.
